purpose: Teach: 車検/よき/よん/缶詰/立ち読み/度々/あした/嫌がらせ

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、彼の車、今月、車検なの、整備工場、お祖父ちゃんに、紹介してもらったわよ、本当に、頼りになる。
lines.en: Aoi — your boyfriend's car is in for inspection this month, and Grandpa introduced us to such a reliable garage.
lines.style: Warm, conversational opening. Gentle pride in the recommendation. Unhurried pacing, natural breathing. A small smile in the voice — the pleasure of having solved something well.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: うん。よきパートナー、見つけたわね、メイちゃん、葵としても、嬉しい、本当に、応援してる、いつも。
lines.en: Yeah. You really did find a good partner, Mei. And as your friend, I'm genuinely happy for you — I'm always cheering you on.
lines.style: Steady and sincere. Direct eye-contact warmth without performance. Slightly slower on the affirmation, letting it land. Breath supports the honesty underneath.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 昨日、夜中の、よん時くらいに、目が、覚めちゃったの、葵、私、最近、寝つき、悪くて。
lines.en: I actually woke up around 4 in the morning yesterday. Aoi, my sleep's been terrible lately.
lines.style: Lighter tone masking something underneath. A small, self-aware laugh on the confession. Slightly faster pacing covering the vulnerability. Trails off slightly, inviting without demanding.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 缶詰のフルーツ、デザートに、使えるかしら、葵で、メニュー、考えてるのよ、新作で、最近、特に。
lines.en: I've been thinking about using canned fruit for a new dessert menu item at the café. I'm especially curious about it lately.
lines.style: Thoughtful, slightly internal focus. Warm curiosity in the voice. Moderate pace, as if working through the idea aloud. No rush — the creative process showing.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 駅前の本屋、立ち読みできる雑誌、結構、品揃え、いいよね、葵、知ってる、私、よく、行くよ。
lines.en: The bookstore by the station has a really good selection of magazines you can browse through. Do you know it? I go there pretty often.
lines.style: Brighter, more animated energy. Natural enthusiasm without overselling. Conversational rhythm, like sharing something small but genuine. Light breath on the questions.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: メイちゃん、度々、葵に、寄ってくれて、本当に、ありがたいよ、私、嬉しいわよ、いつも、毎回。
lines.en: Mei, you stop by to see me so often — I'm really grateful for that. It makes me happy every single time.
lines.style: Warm and direct. Gentle emphasis on 'every single time' — sincerity without sentimentality. Even pacing, steady breath. The voice of someone who notices and remembers.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: あした、彼と、ランチ、約束してるの、葵、緊張するわよ、本当に、新しい店、行くの、初めて。
lines.en: I'm actually a bit nervous about tomorrow — Aoi, I promised my boyfriend lunch at a new place, and it's my first time going there.
lines.style: Softer tone, slightly hesitant. A quiet vulnerability on the admission of nervousness. Gentle pace. Trailing slightly at the end, like checking if this worry is reasonable.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 最近、店、ネットの嫌がらせ、悩まされてるのよ、葵で、メイちゃん、相談、乗ってくれて、感謝、本当に。
lines.en: Aoi, I've been dealing with some online harassment directed at the café lately, and I'm so grateful you've been willing to talk it through with me.
lines.style: Lower register, more inward. Quiet but steady — not collapsed, just honest about the weight. Measured pace. Closes with sincerity and gratitude, voice settling into steadiness.
